providers.reason: Active €400M share buyback program ends October 31, creating ~2 weeks of mechanical buying demand. Stock gained 3.09% on Oct 13 and trades near its 52-week high of €97. H1 2026 showed accelerating growth momentum with improving cash flow, supporting the technical setup.
providers.risk: Buyback concludes in two weeks, removing the demand floor; if broader sentiment softens, the stock lacks a near-term catalyst to sustain momentum above €97.
